_templateInfo.name: Elite K-12 (Institutional Vanguard)
_templateInfo.description: For elite K-12 institutions focusing on innovation, neurodiversity, and HNW migration

personas.label: Known & Valued Parents
personas.description: Public-school switchers seeking safety, accountability, and affordability with financial aid access.

personas.label: Known & Valued Students
personas.description: Students who feel lost in large classes and need a safe, structured environment where they are seen.

personas.label: Optimization & Outcomes Parents
personas.description: Highly research-driven families focused on rigorous academics, pathways, and strong college outcomes.

personas.label: Optimization & Outcomes Students
personas.description: Driven students seeking challenge, competitive peers, and a strong profile for top-tier universities.

personas.label: Whole-Child Parents
personas.description: Families prioritizing character, values, belonging, and whole-child development alongside academics.

personas.label: Whole-Child Students
personas.description: Well-rounded students who thrive in service, leadership, extracurricular depth, and community life.

personas.label: Balanced Specialists Parents
personas.description: Families seeking specialized support or elite athletics without sacrificing a healthy school-life balance.

personas.label: Balanced Specialists Students
personas.description: Talented athletes or niche learners seeking high performance, real friendships, and a normal school experience.

stages.label: Discover
stages.description: Families identify options and define the outcomes that matter most.

stages.label: Research
stages.description: Families evaluate culture, academics, support systems, and student fit in depth.

stages.label: Compare
stages.description: Families benchmark top schools across rigor, community, specialization, and value.

stages.label: Apply
stages.description: Families make the final choice and complete enrollment steps with confidence.
